interpretation.whole: Original fastest sweep includes caller checksum and cleanup; stages aggregate warmup + three timed sweeps in two separate processes.
interpretation.disturbance: Profile/original ratios combine timer, compiler/layout, process/cache and system context. They are not isolated timer-overhead estimates or candidate speedups.
interpretation.cross: words inclusive combines preparation, packets, compute and repair; core exclusive covers output materialization and cleanup outside words.
interpretation.rowstream: Amap and packB are complete low-frequency outer helpers. RowStream scope exclusive combines all remaining compute, output and cleanup.
interpretation.direct: DirectContinuous and DirectSmall are complete compute/output scopes. No per-row or per-output timers exist.
interpretation.conversion: Amap/packB include allocation, fill and conversion; none of their duration is an established removable-cost upper bound.
interpretation.fractions: Nested-exclusive fractions refer only to instrumented pure-root durations of this workload, never official-score shares.
interpretation.route: SOURCE_MODEL from exact generator words + frozen DF control flow; no per-branch machine trace.
interpretation.unknown: Unseparated work and missing/unexecuted boundaries remain UNKNOWN; no official-score or champion multiplier is estimated.
